an6.105:1.1: 105 tayome bhikkhave bhavā pahātabbā tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitabbaṃ
an6.105:1.8: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ime tayo bhavā pahīnā honti imāsu ca tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitasikkho hoti
an6.105:1.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu acchejji taṇhaṃ vivattayi saññojanaṃ sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassāti.
